text:
dina: urgent: multiple tenants getting 401 from /oauth2/introspect after last night's kms rewrap. IdP is returning ok, but our introspect proxy reports invalid signature. Affected tenants: globex, monad, stellaris. Anyone seen this pattern before?
tom: are the id_tokens unsigned or using a new kid? can you paste the raw response headers from proxy?
dina: headers and a sample body from proxy logs: 
```
2025-02-03T03:12:11Z proxy[introspect]: tenant=globex status=401 err="introspect: signature verify failed"
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-Id: req-8f2a

{"error":"invalid_token","error_description":"signature verification failed"}
```
luis: check KMS logs around the rewrap window. If private key was rewrapped and the jwks cache wasn't invalidated, we might be verifying against old key material. idp-bot: jwks-rotation detected for key=k-i0x at 2025-02-03T03:10:45Z; operator=manual; status=completed.
opsbot: deploy oauth-introspect v1.4 rolled at 2025-02-03T02:58:00Z 0% canary.
tom: hmm, two moving parts: jwks rotated on IdP side and we rotated kms-encrypted key material here during the same maintenance window. Possible race: introspect service tried to decrypt old ciphertext while jwks already returned new kid.
dina: That fits: SCIM provisioning webhooks for the same tenants were showing intermittent 202 -> 500s during the same minute. Audit log snippet: 
```
2025-02-03T03:11:03Z scim: patch group role mapping tenant=monad uid=U123 status=202
2025-02-03T03:11:46Z scim: patch group role mapping tenant=monad uid=U123 status=500 err="role-apply: missing-role-definition"
```
security-bot: RBAC audit: detected 17 accounts created without role assignment between 03:10 and 03:15 UTC. Flagged as high-risk window.
luis: immediate mitigations: 1) put oauth-introspect in warm-restart mode to force jwks reload on startup, 2) add short-lived fallback verification to accept previous kid for 30s while propagate rewrap, 3) add scim retrier with backoff for 5 minutes.
dina: I'm going to temporarily pause KMS automated rewraps for maintenance windows and add a preflight that checks jwks age. @eng-infra can you hold rewraps?
opsbot: kms-operator: pause requested by dina. Request id: pause-2025-02-03-0313.
tom: long term: we need a coordinated choreography documented: key rewrap -> jwks publish -> service decrypt refresh -> scim/patch retry window. Also add detection in the Audit pipeline to correlate KMS rewrap and provisioning errors automatically.
luis: I'll file infra/ops tickets for rewrap choreography + add the 30s accept-old-kid fallback in introspect service. Also will backfill the 17 orphaned accounts (audit id backfill-1915).
dina: Thanks. Followups: ENG-INFRA to schedule rewrap freeze for 24h and write choreography doc, ENG-PLATFORM to implement accept-old-kid fallback, ENG-SEC to review orphaned RBAC artifacts and create a rollback/compensating script. Closing once tickets are linked. :white_check_mark:
